verdict.rationale: HeyGen publishes llms.txt at developers.heygen.com/llms.txt, confirmed by a live probe returning HTTP 200 with structured documentation content. Its docs also say every endpoint ships with llms.txt and typed schemas so agents like Claude and Cursor can use the API, and a second llms.txt is served at www.heygen.com. missing for 10: an independent hands-on report of an agent consuming these docs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.heygen.com/llms.txt # HeyGen Documentation
Every endpoint ships with an MCP server, llms.txt, and typed schemas — so Claude, Cursor, and your own agents can generate video without glue code.
